content.short: TrustWallet is a widely used multi-chain Web3 wallet with built-in DApp access and price charts.
content.description: TrustWallet was created by Viktor Radchenko to offer an inclusive, multi-chain wallet that an average user or even a complete newbie can easily navigate. The app integrates with a wide range of DApps, such as PancakeSwap, 1inch, and LooksRare, letting you access these platforms directly from the wallet. It also provides price-tracking charts and supports multiple networks, including Ethereum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, Solana, BNB Chain, Polkadot, Avalanche, Base, Multichain, and Arbitrum.
content.meta: TrustWallet is a widely used multi-chain Web3 wallet. Discover TrustWallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
